says: In today's CI tooling, restLoads, documented as the rest step's load excluding next/, now counts the two kalfa/config rows, which the next vitest legs run, not the rest step.
proof: vitest.shards.ts:141 keeps a row when !path.startsWith("next/"), while vitest.config.ts:39 puts kalfa/*/src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} in the next project's NEXT globs and vitest.shards.json:327,329 hold kalfa/config/src/Toml.types.test.ts and TomlParser.test.ts; the same next/-only filter is repeated at vitest.shards.test.ts:1310, 1321 and 1333.
cost: Lane machines start from loads 0.2 s too high today, and the error grows with every kalfa row added; the four filters must be found and changed together.
